definitions.explanation: The compass direction between north and east.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{北東|ほくとう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{吹|ふ}いている→吹く：02445_fuku⟧。
examples.english: The wind is blowing from the northeast.
There is a park to the northeast of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{北東|ほくとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進路|しんろ}→進路：14321_shinro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}え→変える：01089_kaeru⟧、⟦{太平洋|たいへいよう}→太平洋：09680_taiheiyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}ける→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧⟦{見込|みこ}み→見込み：06872_mikomi⟧だ。
examples.english: The typhoon is expected to change course to the northeast and move out over the Pacific Ocean.

notes:
Composed of {北|ほく} (north) + {東|とう} (east). One of the four intercardinal directions. In traditional Japanese geomancy ({家相|かそう}), the northeast direction is called {鬼門|きもん} (demon gate) and is considered an unlucky direction.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {北東|ほくとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧ — northeast wind
- {北東|ほくとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{位置|いち}する→位置する：09891_ichisuru⟧ — to be located to the northeast
- {北東|ほくとう}⟦{方向|ほうこう}→方向：03617_houkou⟧ — northeast direction
- {北東部|ほくとうぶ} — northeastern part/region

RELATED COMPASS DIRECTIONS:
- ⟦{北西|ほくせい}→北西：30082_hokusei⟧ — northwest
- ⟦{南東|なんとう}→南東：30083_nantou⟧ — southeast
- ⟦{南西|なんせい}→南西：19716_nansei⟧ — southwest
